_comment: Who is reliable on what. Editable without a code change, per Master prompt 5.3
('as people continue training, I will add in who's reliable on this').
STATUS OF THIS FILE: the age-banded assessment names come from the manual.
The per-coordinator rows are UNCONFIRMED and deliberately empty. The master
prompt names Emma, Makenzie and Maggie, none of whom are on the roster the
dashboard and the shared Outlook calendar carry (Margaret Bell, Lauren
Puttock, Sanjana Oak, Sofia Tous, Morgan Soto, Ramiro Lucas-Mariano).
Guessing a mapping would encode a clinical-certification claim about a real
person that nobody verified, so the gates read this file and escalate when
it is empty rather than substituting anyone. Fill in from the manual and the
gates start enforcing immediately - no code change.
status values: RELIABLE | IN_TRAINING | (absent = not certified)
